name: com.lunarct/forms
title: Lunar Creative/Technology forms
description: Estimate a project price, request a quote or contact Lunar Creative/Technology.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a project brief (app, web or interactive installation) to Lunar Creative/Technology, a creative technology studio, to request a tailored quote. Returns the indicative price range and suggested ongoing services, and the team follows up by email, usually within two working days. Use estimate_quote first if the user only wants a price idea. This sends a real enquiry to real people: only call it on the user’s behalf, with details the user provided (never invented), after they confirmed what will be sent.

project.description: Project type. Select one or more. Options: "app" (App), "web" (Web), "installation" (Interactive installation).

designs.description: Designs. Options: "ready" (Designs are ready), "partial" (Partially designed), "needed" (Designs to be provided).

hosting.description: Hosting. Options: "self" (Self-hosting), "managed" (Managed hosting), "unsure" (Not sure — advise me).

tools.name: estimate_quote
tools.description: Get an indicative price range and suggested ongoing services (hosting, maintenance) for an app, web or interactive installation project by Lunar Creative/Technology, from the same questions as its quote request. Nothing is sent to the studio; answer as many questions as are known. Use request_quote to get a tailored quote.

project.description: Project type. Select one or more. Options: "app" (App), "web" (Web), "installation" (Interactive installation).

designs.description: Designs. Options: "ready" (Designs are ready), "partial" (Partially designed), "needed" (Designs to be provided).

hosting.description: Hosting. Options: "self" (Self-hosting), "managed" (Managed hosting), "unsure" (Not sure — advise me).

tools.name: contact_studio
tools.description: Send a general message or idea to Lunar Creative/Technology, a creative technology studio. A person replies by email. This sends a real enquiry to real people: only call it on the user’s behalf, with details the user provided (never invented), after they confirmed what will be sent.

tools.name: headless_wordpress_enquiry
tools.description: Ask Lunar Creative/Technology to review an existing WordPress website for a move to headless WordPress (faster, more secure front-end), keeping or redesigning the current design. A person replies by email. This sends a real enquiry to real people: only call it on the user’s behalf, with details the user provided (never invented), after they confirmed what will be sent.

design.description: What should happen to the design? Options: "keep" (Keep it as it is), "redesign" (Redesign it), "unsure" (Not sure yet).

anything_else_we_should_know.description: Anything else we should know? (optional) — For example, if the site has already been compromised.
